name: wall
description: Wall of liner, ring and housing tube (stick-weld limit: thinner stock burns through)

name: liner_OD
description: Main liner tube OD (common 76.1 x 2.5 tube)

name: ring_OD
description: Head ring tube OD (sits inside the liner, forms the film slot)

name: ring_L
description: Head ring length from the head plate; the cooling film exits at x = ring_L

name: tube_gasket_t
description: Graphite gasket between liner end and head plate (placeholder)

name: liner_start
description: x of the liner upstream end (sits on the tube gasket)

name: overlap_L
description: Axial overlap of liner over head ring (film path length)

name: film_gap
description: Radial film-cooling slot between ring OD and liner ID

name: liner_L
description: x of the liner downstream end (liner length measured from x = 0)

name: main_L
description: Physical length of the main liner tube

name: n_bolt
description: Number of M4 bolts holding the liner on the head ring

name: bolt_hole_d
description: Bolt clearance hole, match-drilled through liner + ring together

name: x_bolt
description: x of the bolt row (head inside the ring, nut outside the liner)

name: phase_bolt
description: Angle of the first bolt from +Z

name: spacer_OD
description: Spacer (film-gap distance piece) OD, one per bolt

name: x_cool
description: Cooling holes: x (liner wall over the ring -> feed the film slot, film exits at x = ring_L)

name: phase_cool
description: Cooling holes: angle of first hole from +Z

name: phase_prim
description: Primary holes: angle of first hole from +Z

name: phase_sec
description: Secondary holes: half a secondary pitch off the primary reference row

name: n_dil_row
description: Dilution holes per row (2 staggered rows, 14 total)

name: phase_dil1
description: Dilution row 1: 1/8 dilution pitch, keeps it off the secondary holes

name: phase_dil2
description: Dilution row 2: staggered half a pitch from row 1

name: area_tol
description: Allowed relative deviation of drilled area from target

name: housing_OD
description: Housing tube OD (bolted assembly, not welded to the liner; graphite gaskets)

name: step_t
description: Flat step plate between DN125 head pipe and 108 housing (spec range 3-4, NOT a cone)

name: stub_OD
description: Inlet stub OD (fits the existing 50.5 mm ID silicone hose)

name: stub_protrude
description: Stub height above the head pipe OD (to the compressor connection)

name: flange_phase
description: Bolt holes straddle the vertical (stub) centreline

name: flange_t
description: Flange thickness, blind and slip-on (placeholder until the bought flange is measured)

name: slipon_setback
description: Pipe end set back inside the slip-on flange face (room for the internal fillet weld)

name: hw_clear
description: Clearance behind slip-on flange for M16 nuts + spanner, up to the stub edge

name: stub_x
description: x of the stub axis = fl_gasket_t + flange_t + hw_clear + stub_OD/2

name: head_L
description: Head pipe end / step plate upstream face = stub_x + stub_OD/2 + 10

name: slip_axial
description: Cold axial clearance, liner end -> end plate (liner grows ~3 mm hot)

name: slip_radial
description: Radial clearance liner OD -> slip sleeve ID

name: sleeve_L
description: Slip sleeve length (cold engagement = sleeve_L - slip_axial)

name: end_t
description: End plate thickness (same plate stock as the step plate)

name: end_hole_d
description: End plate gas outlet bore (exit transition to turbine not modelled)

name: x_end_in
description: x of the end plate inner face

name: air_prim
description: Cumulative air fraction in the primary zone

name: air_sec
description: Cumulative air fraction in the secondary zone

name: L_dil
description: Dilution zone length (rest of the liner)

name: tau_prim
description: Primary residence time target (~20x propane chemistry)

name: dil_LD_min
description: Dilution mixing length, min (in liner diameters)

name: dil_LD_max
description: Dilution mixing length, max (in liner diameters)

name: dT_liner
description: Liner temperature rise, hot vs. assembly

name: radial_hot_min
description: Flag if hot radial slip clearance falls below this

name: leak_frac_max
description: Flag if slip-sleeve leak area exceeds this fraction of the liner hole area

name: material
value: AISI 304 body; E308L filler; graphite gaskets

name: bolt_note
value: Match-drill the 3 bolt holes through liner + ring + spacers in one setup

name: bolt_len
description: M4 bolt length (next standard length that shows ~2 threads past the nut)
